HF.root.model.rotary_emb: HF uses a single model-level Llama4TextRotaryEmbedding instance shared across all attention layers. vLLM uses per-layer RotaryEmbeddingWrapper instances within each self_attn module (for 36 j-layers with RoPE). This is an architectural difference in how RoPE is organized - centralized in HF vs distributed in vLLM. Both are functionally equivalent but not structurally mappable at the component tree level.
HF.root.model.layers.{j}.feed_forward.exper: In HF, Llama4TextExperts has a separate SiLUActivation module (act_fn) that is applied during forward pass: `up * self.act_fn(gate)`. In vLLM, this activation is fused into the SiluAndMul operator that is implicitly applied to the gate_up_proj output in the expert computation kernel. The activation function is not a separate module but part of the fused MoE kernel implementation. Functionally equivalent but architecturally different - HF uses explicit module while vLLM fuses it into optimized kernel.
HF.root.model.layers.{k}.feed_forward.exper: Same reasoning as j-layers. In HF, Llama4TextExperts has explicit SiLUActivation module that is applied during expert forward pass. In vLLM, this activation is fused into the MoE computation kernel (SiluAndMul operation). Not separately mappable - it's part of the fused expert computation.

vLLM.root: Llama4ForConditionalGeneration is a multimodal wrapper containing vision_model, multi_modal_projector, and language_model. Only the language_model subtree maps to HF's text-only model.
vLLM.root.vision_model (and all descendants): Complete vision pipeline including Llama4VisionModel with patch_embedding (Llama4UnfoldConvolution with unfold/linear), layernorm_pre/post, 34 vision encoder layers (each with self_attn using MultiHeadAttention/qkv_proj/o_proj/rotary_emb and mlp using Llama4VisionMLP with fc1/fc2/GELU activation), and vision_adapter (Llama4VisionPixelShuffleMLP). HF model (Llama4ForCausalLM) is text-only and has no vision components.
vLLM.root.multi_modal_projector: Llama4MultiModalProjector with linear_1 (ColumnParallelLinear) for vision-to-language projection. HF model is text-only and has no multi-modal projection component.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{j}.sel: ChunkedLocalAttention kernel module used by vLLM for optimized attention computation in j-layers (36 layers with local attention pattern). HF computes attention inline within Llama4TextAttention.forward() method using PyTorch operations. Functionally equivalent but vLLM uses a separate optimized kernel module while HF uses inline computation.

Per-layer RotaryEmbeddingWrapper in vLLM for j-layers. HF uses single model-level root.model.rotary_emb shared across all layers. Distributed vs centralized RoPE architecture - functionally equivalent but organizationally different.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{k}.sel: Standard Attention kernel module for k-layers (12 layers without chunked/local attention). Same reasoning as j-layers - vLLM uses separate optimized kernel module for attention computation while HF computes attention inline in forward() method.

None value for k-layers that do not use RoPE (layers 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, 31, 35, 39, 43, 47). HF handles absence of RoPE through conditional logic in attention computation rather than having explicit None-valued modules.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{j}.fee: UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod - vLLM's quantization framework interface for j-layers. For unquantized bfloat16 models, this is a pass-through module that applies no transformations. HF accesses expert weights directly as nn.Parameters without a quantization abstraction layer. Framework-level architectural difference - vLLM uses unified quantization interface even for unquantized models.

In vLLM's SharedFusedMoE implementation for j-layers, _shared_experts is an internal reference to the shared_expert module passed during initialization (see SharedFusedMoE.__init__: self._shared_experts = shared_experts). This enables overlapped computation optimization where shared expert computation can be interleaved with all-to-all communication. Not a distinct component - it's the same object as root.language_model.model.layers.{j}.feed_forward.shared_expert. The actual mapping is at the shared_expert level.
vLLM.root.language_model.model.layers.{k}.fee: Same as j-layers. UnquantizedFusedMoEMethod for vLLM's quantization framework interface. Pass-through for unquantized models. No HF equivalent.

Same as j-layers. Internal reference to shared_expert module for computation overlap optimization in SharedFusedMoE. Not a separate component to map - it references the same object as root.language_model.model.layers.{k}.feed_forward.shared_expert.
vLLM.root.language_model.logits_processor: vLLM's LogitsProcessor for sampling post-processing (temperature scaling, top-k/top-p filtering, repetition penalties, etc.). HF handles these transformations in the generate() method and GenerationMixin outside the model module tree. Framework-level difference in generation pipeline organization - vLLM includes post-processing in model tree, HF treats it as a generation utility separate from the model.
